seo_description: Work with Exploreans at Mara River Camp and Watamu Beach Club & Villas. Guides, hosts, makers and naturalists who know their place by heart.
title: Share the place you know by heart
lead: Every Exploreans experience is led by someone who belongs to the place. If you know a river, a reef or a kitchen by heart and love showing it to others, we would like to hear from you.
alt: A guide and a guest standing among the rocks of the Mara River

roles.headline: The people who lead the way

items.name: Guides
items.body: They lead the walks, the drives and the mornings on the water, and know every track and tide.

items.name: Hosts
items.body: They welcome guests by name and look after every detail of the stay, from first light to the last fire.

items.name: Makers
items.body: Cooks, craftspeople and artisans who bring the place to the table and into guests' hands.

items.name: Naturalists
items.body: They read the land, the river and the reef, and share what they know with curiosity and care.

apply.headline: Send us your story
apply.body: Write to us with your CV and a few lines about the place you know best. Open roles across Exploreans are listed on the Planhotel Hospitality Group careers page.
